title: Tori's Modpack
description: A lightweight Minecraft modpack focused on enhancing multiplayer communication, navigation, and streaming interaction.
body:
Tori’s Modpack is a calm and immersive Minecraft experience designed for players who simply want to enjoy the beauty of survival by building, exploring, and relaxing without unnecessary complexity.

This pack focuses on smooth performance, visual comfort, and light quality of life improvements that enhance the vanilla feeling without breaking it. Whether you want to chill alone, build creative structures, or play with friends using Simple Voice Chat, everything feels natural and optimized.

🌿 Key Features

Enhanced visuals and shaders: Iris Shaders, Sodium, Entity Texture Features, Distant Horizons for smoother graphics and extended render distance.

Better immersion: Sound Physics Remastered, ReplayMod, 3D Skin Layers, Freecam.

Quality of life upgrades: InventoryHUD+, Mouse Tweaks, Crafting Tweaks, Nemo’s Inventory Sorting, BetterF3, Clumps.

Exploration tools: Xaero’s Minimap and World Map for clear navigation.

Performance and stability: FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling, spark.

Community features: Streamotes, Simple Voice Chat, Auto Reconnect Reforged.

Tori’s Modpack lets you play Minecraft the way it was meant to be calm, creative, and connected. Build your world at your own pace, share moments with friends, and rediscover the joy of simple survival.
